[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Cariso Smadis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|trooper]] and [[Rebel Marine|marine]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was stationed aboard the Alliance [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], the [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], as it carried recently stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|technical data]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Smadis fought to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|defend]] the ''Tantive IV'' from a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] boarding party attached to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] pursuing [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Cariso Smadis<ref name="Force Collection" /> served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as an [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]<ref name="ANH" /> and [[Rebel Marine|marine]]<ref name="TCG" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ANH" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Smadis had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]].<ref name="Visual Guide">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 3: Imperial Boarding Party}}</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> he<ref name="Force Collection" /> was one of the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] stationed aboard [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], when Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] transmitted data to her [[Consular ship/Legends|vessel]] containing the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="ANH" />

The ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} possession of the plans led to its pursuit and [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|overtaking]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]]. Smadis and his fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] took defensive positions in the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] corridors before engaging an invading [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] boarding party. The skirmish ended in victory for the Empire and resulted in Organa's capture. However, the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] evacuated the ''Tantive IV'' amidst the fighting with the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] plans in tow.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Rebel Marines like Smadis were trained for combat on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], either to repel invaders or to board ships.<ref name="TCG" /> Smadis was driven by bravery and a belief in the Alliance's ideal of freedom.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Warrior's Courage}}</ref> He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
Smadis wore<ref name="ANH" /> the standard [[Alliance Fleet trooper uniform|uniform]] for Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] includes a depiction of the standard [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|trooper]] uniforms, which matches the outfit worn by Cariso Smadis.</ref> during the ''Tantive IV'' battle. He was armed with a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cariso Smadis first appeared as one of the Rebel troopers aboard ''Tantive IV'' in the opening battle of the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. He was played by an uncredited extra,<ref name="ANH" /> whose scenes were filmed on Stage 9 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[June 29]] and [[July 16]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Smadis was first named in the [[April 30]], [[2007]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20080611113953/http://www.starwars.com/episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html third chapter] of [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Visual Guides]] feature, which provided a behind-the-scenes look at ''A New Hope''.<ref name="Visual Guide" />
